title: The Influence Function of Transport-based Quantiles
summary: Transport-based quantiles extend univariate quantiles to multivariate distributions via optimal transport. We study the influence function of the transport quantile map $\mathbf{Q}_P$, defined as the optimal transport map pushing a fixed reference measure $μ$ forward to a target distribution $P$. For the Huber contamination $P_t=(1-t)P+tδ_{x_0}$, we prove that the first-order limit $\mathbf{I}(x_0;\mathbf{Q}_P(z)) := \lim_{t\downarrow 0} [\mathbf{Q}_{(1-t)P+tδ_{x_0}}(z)-\mathbf{Q}_P(z)]/t$ exists whenever $x_0\ne \mathbf{Q}_P(z)$ and characterize it uniquely.
